about.title: FocusPanda
about.subtitle: The Path to Spiritual Growth
about.intro: Askez is a unique app designed to support your journey in asceticism and spiritual growth. We help you strengthen your spirit through practices of self-restraint and discipline.
about.section1_text: Asceticism is the practice of abstaining from worldly pleasures to pursue spiritual goals. It is a path of self-discipline that helps cultivate inner strength and spiritual clarity.
about.section3_text: Our mission is to help you build spiritual strength through ascetic practices, offering tools and support along your path to spiritual excellence.
